findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Timing attack in signature comparison
 * @description Using == to compare cryptographic signatures is vulnerable to timing attacks.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/timing-attack
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-208
 */
import python

from Compare cmp, Call c
where
    cmp.getOp(0) instanceof Eq and
    (
        c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = "hexdigest" or
        c.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = "digest"
    ) and
    (
        cmp.getComparator(0).contains(c) or
        cmp.getLeft().contains(c)
    )
select cmp, "Potential timing attack: comparing cryptographic signatures using ==."
findings.hypothesis: Comparing cryptographic signatures using standard comparison operators allows for timing attacks.
